rationale: New follow-up commit (d00b8e2f3) replaces whitespace-nowrap on the Cost header with truncate on all four thead text cells (Model, Provider, Capabilities, Cost / 1M tokens). Table is table-fixed with explicit colgroup widths, so truncate's overflow:hidden/text-overflow:ellipsis/white-space:nowrap applies correctly on each th. This mirrors the already-approved body-cell truncation pattern (CR-001, resolved) and keeps header text from overflowing/wrapping after the column rebalance (Cost 35%->22%). Scoped, minimal, no regressions.

business_review.item: AC1: all rows have the same size

AC3: no row visibly wider/narrower than others when scrolled

Follow-up: header cells truncate instead of overflowing/wrapping after column rebalance
